itinerary.title: Arrival in Negombo & The Coconut Coast
itinerary.description: Meet your private historian-concierge upon arrival at Colombo International Airport. Transfer 25 minutes north to a serene 19th-century coastal manor in Negombo. Settle in with a fresh king coconut and lemongrass infusion. In the late afternoon, embark on an unhurried wooden outrigger cruise along the historic Dutch Canal, learning how spice traders shaped this coast.

itinerary.title: Journey North to the Ancient Capital of Anuradhapura
itinerary.description: Drive into the dry zone heartland to Anuradhapura. In the afternoon, pay reverence at the sacred Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi tree, listening to the rhythmic murmur of white-clad pilgrims. Stroll beneath the colossal white dome of Ruwanwelisaya stupa as oil lamps are lit at dusk, filling the evening air with the scent of jasmine and coconut oil.

itinerary.title: Hydraulic Marvels & Monastic Forest Hermitages
itinerary.description: Explore the ancient monastic city of Ritigala, a 3rd-century BCE forest retreat where stone walking pathways wind through dense evergreen foliage. In the afternoon, witness the engineering ingenuity of the ancient reservoir networks (tanks) that transformed this arid plain into an agricultural powerhouse.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Sky Citadel at Sunrise & Dambulla Caves
itinerary.description: Rise at 5:45 AM to begin our ascent of Sigiriya Rock Fortress while the morning air is crisp. Marvel at the 1,500-year-old cloud maiden frescoes and climb through the colossal Lion's Paws to the summit royal palace. In the afternoon, ascend the granite slopes of Dambulla to witness the subterranean caverns adorned with gilded statues and vibrant Buddhist ceiling murals.

itinerary.title: Bicycle Circuit of Medieval Polonnaruwa
itinerary.description: Mount vintage heritage bicycles for an unhurried ride through the shaded stone courtyards of Polonnaruwa. Stand before the monumental rock-carved statues of Gal Vihara and examine the intricate moonstones carved with animal friezes. Evening cooking masterclass preparing heirloom black pepper curries with a local village matriarch.

itinerary.title: Ascent to the Royal Hill Capital of Kandy
itinerary.description: Journey through the spice hills of Matale, stopping at an organic agro-forestry garden to smell fresh green cardamom pods, cinnamon quills, and wild nutmeg. Arrive in the royal hill city of Kandy. In the evening, attend the ceremonial puja drumming inside the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic during VIP hours.

itinerary.title: Royal Botanical Gardens & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning private stroll through Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens with an ethnobotanist, admiring giant Javan fig trees and rare orchids cultivated for the Kandyan kings. Private transfer to Colombo or extend your journey south toward the coast.

itinerary.title: Welcome to the Dutch Fort of Galle
itinerary.description: Arrive in Galle via the scenic Southern Highway. Check into your restored Dutch colonial merchant house. At 4:30 PM, meet our resident architectural conservationist for a private ramparts circuit, learning about coral-stone construction, underground Dutch sewer networks, and the trading battles between the Portuguese and VOC.

itinerary.title: Cinnamon Islands & Traditional Mask Ateliers
itinerary.description: Morning wooden boat excursion across Koggala Lake to a secluded cinnamon island. Watch third-generation peelers delicately strip the paper-thin inner bark of true Ceylon cinnamon (*Cinnamomum verum*). Afternoon visit to a master mask carver preserving 300-year-old Kolam theatrical folklore.

itinerary.title: Artisan Jewellers & Farewell Coast
itinerary.description: Discover the centuries-old gem cutting and filigree craft of Galle's Moorish quarter. Conclude with an oceanfront brunch of freshly baked hoppers and tropical fruits before transfer back to Colombo.

itinerary.title: Ascent into Little England: Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Climb into the mist-shrouded central mountains. Explore Nuwara Eliya with its Tudor-style post office, colonial hill club, and manicured golf greens. Settle into your restored tea planter's bungalow with afternoon tea and freshly baked scones.
itinerary.stay: Ceylon Tea Trails / Heritance Tea Factory

itinerary.title: The Historic Train Journey to Ella & The Viaduct
itinerary.description: Board the vintage mountain train as it click-clacks over stone bridges and through mountain tunnels cut by hand in the 1880s. Disembark at Ella and walk the pine trail to the Nine Arches Bridge just as the afternoon train crosses the majestic chasm.

itinerary.title: Lipton's Seat Sunrise & Descent
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn 4WD ascent to Lipton's Seat where Sir Thomas Lipton once stood to oversee his verdant estate. Watch the sun illuminate five distinct southern provinces before descending through cascading waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Full Day Galle Fort & Coast
itinerary.description: Depart hotel at 7:30 AM. Arrive in Galle Fort by 9:30 AM for a fascinating 3-hour walking masterclass through VOC warehouses, the Dutch hospital, and colonial ramparts. Savor a slow 8-curry clay pot lunch. Afternoon visit to coastal cinnamon gardens before returning at sunset.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya & Ancient Tank Safari
